spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_liquid_fade
spec.hypothesis: Extreme taker buy/sell volume imbalance in liquid large-cap/ETF names is followed by short-horizon price reversion (fade), net of T1 costs, because aggressive order flow exhausts touch liquidity rather than signaling informed continuation.
spec.power_argument: Prior order-flow-adjacent tests (sprint32/34) showed per-trade sigma ~80-100bps (t=-18 to -20 at n=1600-4200). At n>=300 this implies a detectable edge floor of ~10-15bps at t=2, comfortably below the 20-40bps typical claimed magnitude for order-flow reversion signals, so the design is powered to reject or confirm.

errors: closed-door terms ['taker_imbalance']: registry says these families are dead at daily frequency; a NEW mechanism must be argued explicitly
